name: no.locl/events
title: Locl – hva skjer i norske byer
description: Events and places in Norwegian cities from official organiser calendars, with time, venue and link.

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: Real events (concerts, theatre, exhibitions, film, talks, family) in a Norwegian city from official organiser calendars, with time, venue, price and ticket/source link. Times are Europe/Oslo.

tools.name: open_now
tools.description: Places (cafés, restaurants, bars, museums, shops, parks) that are open right now according to their published OpenStreetMap opening hours. Optionally sorted by distance from a point. Places with unknown hours are never reported as open.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Cities and places covered by Locl, with whether they have live event sources.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Event venues in Norwegian cities that may be for hire (event venues, conference centres, community halls, arts centres, concert halls, theatres) from OpenStreetMap via Locl. Returns name, type, for_hire (confirmed / likely / unconfirmed), position, website and a Locl page with a free request form ("Lei lokalet"). Capacity is often unknown.
